crossRefs.note: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and…
I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge…
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

translations.web: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
translations.bsb: Who gave Him charge over the earth? Who appointed Him over the whole world?
translations.kjv: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
translations.asv: Who gave him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?
